notes.title: Sonic Superstars – Patch Ver. 1.0.1.5
notes.content:
Update ver. 1.0.1.5 for Sonic Superstars is live now! This update offers bug fixes and the option to reset Time Attack scores. Please be sure to download before playing Sonic Superstars.

*This Time Attack score reset feature will reset only your own score on the local save data. Scores shown on “Top Rank” will not be affected by this.

notes.title: Update ver. 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
We've heard your feedback and are pleased to announce the release of update ver. 1.0.0.8 
This update removes the need to login with an Epic Games account to access Online Battle Mode. 
Stay tuned to this space for future updates.

notes.title: Update About Cross-Platform Play in Online Battle Mode
notes.content: Today, we are releasing a patch that moves the Epic Game account login prompt from appearing at game startup to only appearing when a player starts online Battle Mode. This login is currently required to play in online Battle Mode on Steam. You should no longer see the prompt once you have synched your Epic and Steam accounts. Stay tuned to this space for future updates.

notes.title: Sonic Superstars Launches October 17th! Pre-Order Now!
notes.content:
Sonic Superstars launches October 17th! Adventure through the mystical Northstar Islands in this all-new take on classic 2D Sonic high-speed action platforming. Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, and Amy and harness all-new Emerald powers to move and attack in dynamic new ways. Play with up to three other players in drop-in and drop-out local co-op or challenge up to seven players online or three players locally in the new Battle Mode. Navigate gorgeous, never-before-seen environments and stop Dr. Eggman, Fang, and a mysterious new adversary from converting the islands’ giant animals into Badniks before it’s too late!
